newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria's OMV pumps up H1 profits.
newsitem.headline: Austria's OMV pumps up H1 profits.

text.p: Austrian oil and chemicals group OMV AG, the country's biggest industrial concern, pumped up a 100 percent rise in half-year earnings on Tuesday, fuelled by cost-cuts and good market conditions.

Helped by a strong performance of its "three pillars" -- exploration & production (E&P), gas and marketing -- which analysts expect to drive above average earnings growth, OMV said earnings before interest and tax (EBIT) soared to 3.11 billion schillings from 1.52 billion.
Pre-tax profits in the six months to June 30 jumped to 2.93 billion schillings from 1.56 billion.

However, on a net level, the profit rise was more modest after exceptional charges, climbing to 1.35 billion from 1.24 billion schillings. Group sales, excluding oil tax, grew to 45.31 billion schillings from 37.35 in the half year.
"This dramatic profit growth is due to persistently good market conditions and a consistent focus on cost manangement," the company said in its results statement.

Analysts had expected OMV to outstrip most rivals in the sector, helped by new volumes from its Libyan Murzak production field and a strong dollar as well as solid European demand and long-term contracts in its gas business.
